summary.headline: Chaldean Twelve-Year Cycle
summary.text: A newly edited Chaldean twelve-year cycle, or dodecaeteris, drawing on an Orphic Dodecaeterides and Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos II, 12, with notes on Vaticanus 1290 and Monacensis 287. The excerpt describes annual conditions ruled by Aries, Taurus, Gemini, and Cancer, including war, rain, crop yields, drought, fruit, winter, plague, and the destruction of Gemini’s year by Cancer.
